inspection.reviewer: Codex S112 root plus browser_recon, recovery_ledger, and product_recon visual reviewers
inspection.reviewMethod: 143 final PNGs inspected with an image-capable tool; 55 carried forward only after exact SHA-256 equality to individually inspected 4e16a7 PNGs. Coverage: 134 game frames (116 fresh, 18 identical), 24 tutorial/advisor frames (20 fresh, 4 identical), and 40 public frames (7 fresh, 33 identical).
findings: No remaining concrete visual defect in the reviewed desktop, mobile, tablet drawer, dark, or light frames. Before-state archives retain the observed CSP/mobile tutorial and contrast failures.
fixesApplied: Shared stylesheet replaces dynamically injected style blocks under the actual production CSP.
Mobile tutorial controls stay above the bottom navigation; primary controls meet the captured touch-target checks.
Owner confidence, mastery evidence, Hall of Fame panel, endzone labels, persona guidance, simulation emphasis, community links, chart labels, and warning/success text use readable theme-aware colors.
Filled SCORE, turnover, warning/critical inbox, and moment-share controls use the appropriate theme foreground.
limitations: Synthetic states prove rendering, not gameplay semantics; gameplay behavior is covered by separate tests.
Moment-card frames prove the share control, not an exported card.
Animation timing and scrolling can vary screenshot crops; inherited reviews require exact byte equality.
Automated contrast samples cover selected tips and filled labels, not every pixel in the application.
